desc.zh: 把全 1 矩形变成逐行高度，推导单调栈的宽度边界。
desc.en: Turn all-one rectangles into row heights and derive stack width boundaries.

complexity: O(rows × cols) time · O(cols) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Histogram heights
concepts.description: Consecutive ones encode rectangles ending at each row.

concepts.name: Monotonic stack
concepts.description: Settle a pending height when a shorter bar fixes its right boundary.
